question: How much water carried by the Indus river system can India use under the Indus water treaty (1960)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**20%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indus water treaty (1960)**

 
 
• **​**The Indus Water Treaty is a water-distribution treaty **signed between India and Pakistan on 19 September 1960**.
 
• The treaty was signed by then **Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru and the President of Pakistan, Ayub Khan**.
 
• It was brokered by the **World Bank**.
 
• The treaty gives **India 20%** of the water from the Indus river system and the rest **80% to Pakistan**.
 
• Treaty gives India control over **3 eastern rivers (Beas, Ravi and Sutlej).**
 
• Pakistan gets control of **3 western rivers (Chenab, Indus and Jhelum)**.
 
• The treaty allows India to use the waters of the western rivers for **limited irrigation use** and **non-consumable use** for applications like **power generation, navigation etc.**
